purpose: Teach: オペレーティングシステム/電機/アスキー/スペル/エフェクト/パワーアップ/ポチッ/メッセンジャー
target_vocab: オペレーティングシステム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、オペレーティングシステムの選定に時間をかけられた
lines.en: When you started the company, you spent considerable time choosing the operating system.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recall. Voice carries the weight of memory — not heavy, but aware. Slight pause between clauses, like turning pages of the past. Warm respect underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは電機メーカーから独立した経緯がある
lines.en: Yes. Your father had left an electronics manufacturer to start on his own.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. A son speaking about his father with quiet pride. Clear, unhurried. The tone of someone who has thought about this many times and still stands by it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、アスキー文字コードに詳しかった
lines.en: When you were younger, you knew ASCII code inside and out.
lines.style: Soft nostalgic smile in the voice. Slight wistfulness — not sad, but tender toward that younger version. Eyes slightly distant. A small exhale before the memory settles.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは英文書類のスペルにも厳しかった
lines.en: Yes. And your father was exacting about the spelling in English documents.
lines.style: Steady, acknowledging. Not defensive — just factual recall of a person's particulars. A son recognizing his father's precision without apology. Even pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、広告のエフェクトの拘りが強かった
lines.en: You were meticulous about effects in advertising work.
lines.style: Voice carries gentle admiration mixed with nostalgia. Slower pace. Almost wondering — not judging, just noticing something true about someone he knew well. Soft trailing at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業のパワーアップを毎年掲げられた
lines.en: Yes. Every year, your father would declare a new push to strengthen the business.
lines.style: Calm affirmation with underlying respect. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Not fast, not slow — the pace of someone honoring a pattern he lived beside. Clear without being emphatic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、社内の押しボタンを「ポチッ」と試されてた
lines.en: Back then, you used to test every button on the office equipment — just to hear that little click.
lines.style: A small, knowing warmth enters the voice. Gentler pace. Almost a suppressed smile. The affection of remembering a specific habit, a small harmless quirk. Tender without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはメッセンジャー時代の到来を予見された
lines.en: Yes. You foresaw the age of messaging before anyone else did.
lines.style: Reverent calm. Voice settles with finality — not grand, but certain. A son acknowledging his father's foresight. The tone of closing a circle. Warmth and respect held in perfect balance. Slight pause at the end, like placing something down carefully.
